learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
I like and I don't like are your first two English sentences about you.

Put a thing after them: I like coffee. · I don't like Mondays.

⭐
It is a fixed phrase. You only change the last part.

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
Use it to say what you enjoy and what you don't enjoy.

☕ Food & drink
I like tea.
📅 Days
I don't like Mondays.
🎵 Free time
I like music.

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
I+like / don't like+a thing
➕ PositiveI like coffee.
➖ NegativeI don't like Mondays.

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
I like coffee. And you?
I don't like coffee. I like tea.

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
I no like coffee.  ✓ I don't like coffee.
✗
I not like tea.  ✓ I don't like tea.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
Two blocks: I like + thing · I don't like + thing.
🔊
don't = do + not. Say it as one word: /dəʊnt/.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• I like + a thing you enjoy.
  • I don't like + a thing you don't enjoy.
  • Only the last word changes.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: I like — «мне нравится», I don't like — «мне не нравится». Это готовая фраза: вы меняете только слово в конце.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html: I like — «ұнайды», I don't like — «ұнамайды». Бұл дайын тіркес: тек соңындағы сөзді ауыстырасыз.

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
I like + предмет · I don't like + предмет.

По-русски «я не люблю понедельники» — в английском нужен don't: I don't like Mondays.

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
I like + зат · I don't like + зат.

Болымсыз түрде don't міндетті: I don't like Mondays.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• I like + то, что нравится.
  • I don't like + то, что не нравится.
  • Меняется только последнее слово.

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• I like + ұнайтын нәрсе.
  • I don't like + ұнамайтын нәрсе.
  • Тек соңғы сөз өзгереді.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
I'm = I am. You're = you are. Use them to say who you are.

To ask, put are first: Are you Tom?

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
🙋 Say your name
I'm Anna.
❓ Ask a name
What's your name?
✅ Yes / no
Are you Tom?

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
I+am→I'm
II am Anna. → I'm Anna.
youYou are Tom. → You're Tom.
❓ QuestionAre you Tom?
💬 Short answerYes, I am. / No, I'm not.

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
Hello! What's your name?
I'm Anna. Are you Tom?
Yes, I am. Nice to meet you!

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
I Anna.  ✓ I'm Anna.
✗
You are Tom?  ✓ Are you Tom?
✗
Yes, I'm.  ✓ Yes, I am.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🔄
Flip it! You are → Are you?
⭐
Never drop am / are. English always needs the verb.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• I'm = I am · You're = you are.
  • Question: Are you…?
  • Short answer: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: I'm = I am («я …»), You're = you are («ты …»). Чтобы задать вопрос, ставим are вперёд: Are you Tom?

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html: I'm = I am, You're = you are. Сұрақ қою үшін are алдыға шығады: Are you Tom?

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
⚠ По-русски «Я Анна» — без глагола. В английском глагол am обязателен: I'm Anna.

Краткий ответ: Yes, I am. (никогда «Yes, I'm».)

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
⚠ Қазақшада «Мен Аннамын» — етістіксіз. Ағылшынша am міндетті: I'm Anna.

Қысқа жауап: Yes, I am. («Yes, I'm» деуге болмайды.)

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• I'm = I am · You're = you are.
  • Вопрос: Are you…?
  • Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• I'm = I am · You're = you are.
  • Сұрақ: Are you…?
  • Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
One thing = singular. Two or more = plural.

For a plural, add -s: book → books.

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
Use plurals for numbers, prices, PIN codes and phone numbers — any time there is more than one.

🔢 Numbers
two books
📦 Boxes
three boxes
📱 Phones
ten phones

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
number+noun + s
most nounsbook → books, phone → phones
after s, x, ch, shbox → boxes, watch → watches
⭐
The number comes before the noun: two books, not “books two”.

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
How many books?
Two books and three boxes, please.

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
two book  ✓ two books
✗
three boxs  ✓ three boxes
✗
books two  ✓ two books

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
Hiss first? s, x, ch, sh → add -es. Everything else → -s.
🔊
-es is an extra sound: boxes = /ˈbɒksɪz/.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• More than one → add -s.
  • After s, x, ch, sh → add -es.
  • Number first: two books.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: Один предмет — единственное число. Два и больше — множественное: добавляем -s: book → books.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html: Бір зат — жекеше. Екі және одан көп — көпше: -s жалғанады: book → books.

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
После s, x, ch, sh добавляем -es: box → boxes.

⚠ Число ставится перед существительным: two books.

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
s, x, ch, sh-тан кейін -es жалғанады: box → boxes.

⚠ Сан зат есімнің алдында тұрады: two books.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• Больше одного → -s.
  • После s, x, ch, sh → -es.
  • Сначала число: two books.

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• Біреуден көп → -s.
  • s, x, ch, sh-тан кейін → -es.
  • Алдымен сан: two books.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html: am, is and are are the three forms of the verb be. You choose the form from the person.

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
Use be to say where someone is from.

🌍 Country
I'm from Japan.
🚫 Not true
He isn't from Russia.
❓ Ask
Where are you from?

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
Iam → I'm from Japan.
he / she / itis → She's from Brazil.
you / we / theyare → They're from Turkey.

Negative — add not:

II'm not from Spain.
he / she / itHe isn't from Russia.
you / we / theyWe aren't from the USA.
⭐
Countries take no the: I'm from Japan. But: the UK, the USA.

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
Where are you from?
I'm from Japan. And you?
I'm from the UK. My friend is from Brazil.

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
She are from Brazil.  ✓ She is from Brazil.
✗
They is from Turkey.  ✓ They are from Turkey.
✗
I'm from the Japan.  ✓ I'm from Japan.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
Say it as a rhythm: “I am, he/she/it is, the rest are.”
🗣️
In speech we contract: I'm, she's, they're, isn't, aren't.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• am → I · is → he/she/it · are → you/we/they.
  • Negative = form of be + not.
  • Ask: Where are you from?

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: am / is / are — три формы глагола be. Форму выбираем по лицу: I → am, he/she/it → is, you/we/they → are.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html: am / is / are — be етістігінің үш формасы: I → am, he/she/it → is, you/we/they → are.

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
Отрицание: добавляем not → I'm not · he isn't · we aren't.

⚠ Страны идут без the: I'm from Japan. Но: the UK, the USA.

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
Болымсыз түр: not қосамыз → I'm not · he isn't · we aren't.

⚠ Ел атаулары the-сіз: I'm from Japan. Бірақ: the UK, the USA.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• am → I · is → he/she/it · are → you/we/they.
  • Отрицание = форма be + not.
  • Вопрос: Where are you from?

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• am → I · is → he/she/it · are → you/we/they.
  • Болымсыз түр = be + not.
  • Сұрақ: Where are you from?

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
my, your, his, her, our, their say who someone belongs to. They go before the person or thing.

With a name, add 's: Anna's mother.

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
👨‍👩‍👧 Family
This is my mother.
👨 A man's
This is his sister.
👩 A woman's
This is her father.

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
Imy mother
youyour brother
hehis sister
sheher father
weour family
theytheir house
name+'s+person

Anna's mother = the mother of Anna.

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
Who is this?
This is my sister. And this is Anna's brother.
Is she your mother?
Yes, she's my mother.

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
the mother of Anna  ✓ Anna's mother
✗
He is her brother. (about a man's brother)  ✓ He is his brother.
✗
This is my.  ✓ This is my sister.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
he → his, she → her. Look at the owner, not at the person you describe.
⭐
These words never take -s: my books, not “mys books”.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• my / your / his / her / our / their + person.
  • Name + 's = Anna's mother.
  • Use be with them: She is my sister.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html:
my, your, his, her, our, their показывают, чей это человек или предмет. Они стоят перед словом.

С именем добавляем 's: Anna's mother.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html:
my, your, his, her, our, their — тәуелдік сөздер, зат есімнің алдында тұрады.

Есіммен 's қосылады: Anna's mother.

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
⚠ Смотрите на владельца: мужчина → his, женщина → her.

⚠ «мама Анны» = Anna's mother, а не «the mother of Anna».

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
⚠ Иесіне қараңыз: ер адам → his, әйел адам → her.

⚠ «Аннаның анасы» = Anna's mother.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• my / your / his / her / our / their + человек.
  • Имя + 's = Anna's mother.
  • С ними используем be: She is my sister.

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• my / your / his / her / our / their + адам.
  • Есім + 's = Anna's mother.
  • be қолданылады: She is my sister.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
Say how you feel with be + adjective: I'm happy. She's tired.

Answer a be-question with a short answer: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
😊 Feelings
I'm happy.
😴 Tired
She's tired.
🙂 Polite
How are you? — I'm fine, thanks.

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
subject+am / is / are+adjective
Are you tired?Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Is he OK?Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
Are they busy?Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
⭐
Match the verb: Are you…? → I am. Is he…? → he is.

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
How are you?
I'm fine, thanks. Are you tired?
Yes, I am. It's a long day!

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
Yes, I'm.  ✓ Yes, I am.
✗
I have 20 years.  ✓ I'm 20.
✗
Are you tired? — Yes, I do.  ✓ Yes, I am.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
The question word comes back in the answer: Are → am / are. Is → is.
⭐
Positive short answers are never contracted.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• Feelings: I'm + adjective.
  • Short answer keeps be: Yes, I am / No, he isn't.
  • Never say “Yes, I'm.”

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html:
Чувства: be + прилагательное — I'm happy, She's tired.

Краткий ответ повторяет форму be: Yes, I am.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html:
Сезім: be + сын есім — I'm happy, She's tired.

Қысқа жауап be формасын қайталайды: Yes, I am.

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
⚠ Утвердительный краткий ответ не сокращается: «Yes, I am», а не «Yes, I'm».

⚠ Возраст: I'm 20 (не «I have 20 years»).

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
⚠ Болымды қысқа жауап қысқармайды: «Yes, I am».

⚠ Жас: I'm 20.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• Чувства: I'm + прилагательное.
  • Краткий ответ сохраняет be.
  • Никогда: «Yes, I'm».

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• Сезім: I'm + сын есім.
  • Қысқа жауап be-ні сақтайды.
  • «Yes, I'm» деуге болмайды.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
Before a job you need one small word: a or an.

a teacher · an engineer

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
Use a / an when you say your job or someone's job.

🧑‍🏫 Your job
I'm a teacher.
🧑‍⚕️ Her job
She's a doctor.
❓ Ask
What do you do?

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
a + consonant sounda teacher · a doctor · a nurse
an + vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u)an engineer · an artist · an office worker
I'm+a / an+job

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
What do you do?
I'm a nurse. And you?
I'm an engineer.

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
I'm teacher.  ✓ I'm a teacher.
✗
I'm a engineer.  ✓ I'm an engineer.
✗
She's a artist.  ✓ She's an artist.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
Listen to the sound, not the letter. a, e, i, o, u sound → an.
🔊
a is weak: /ə/. an joins the next word: an_engineer.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• Jobs always take a or an.
  • Vowel sound → an.
  • Ask: What do you do?

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html:
Перед профессией нужен артикль: a teacher, an engineer.

⚠ По-русски «Я учитель» — без артикля. В английском он обязателен.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html:
Мамандықтың алдында артикль керек: a teacher, an engineer.

⚠ Қазақшада артикль жоқ, ағылшыншада міндетті.

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
an — перед гласным звуком (a, e, i, o, u): an artist, an office worker.

Смотрим на звук, а не на букву.

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
an — дауысты дыбыстың алдында: an artist, an office worker.

Әріпке емес, дыбысқа қараймыз.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• Профессия всегда с a / an.
  • Гласный звук → an.
  • Вопрос: What do you do?

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• Мамандық әрқашан a / an алады.
  • Дауысты дыбыс → an.
  • Сұрақ: What do you do?

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html: Say what exists in a place. One thing → There's a…. More than one → There are….

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
🏠 One room
There's a kitchen.
🛏️ Two rooms
There are two bedrooms.
❓ Ask
Is there a garden?

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
There's+a+one thing
There are+number+things
❓ QuestionIs there a garden? — Yes, there is.
📍 Wherein · on · next to · near · on the left / right

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
Where do you live?
I live in a flat. There's a kitchen and there are two bedrooms.
Is there a balcony?
Yes, there is — next to the kitchen.

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
There is two bedrooms.  ✓ There are two bedrooms.
✗
There's kitchen.  ✓ There's a kitchen.
✗
Is there garden?  ✓ Is there a garden?

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
Count first! One → There's. Two or more → There are.
🗣️
We almost always say There's, not “There is”.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• There's a + one thing.
  • There are + number + things.
  • Ask: Is there a…? — Yes, there is.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: Что есть в помещении: один предмет → There's a…, несколько → There are….

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html: Бөлмеде не бар: бір зат → There's a…, бірнеше → There are….

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
⚠ Сначала посчитайте: 1 → There's a; 2+ → There are.

Вопрос: Is there a…? — Yes, there is.

kk.title: Құрылымы

learn.title: What is this grammar?

I get up at 7.

She gets up at 7.

He goes to work by bus.

learn.html:
I / you / we / they+get up
he / she / it+gets up

most verbswork → works
-o, -ch, -shgo → goes, watch → watches
consonant + ystudy → studies

learn.html:
Two verbs describe people. Use be + adjective for what someone is, and have / has for hair and eyes.

He's tall. · She has long hair.

learn.title: When do we use it?

📏 Height & age
He's tall. She's young.
💇 Hair & eyes
She has long hair.
😊 Personality
He's friendly.

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
be + adjectiveShe's tall. · They are kind.
has / have + hair, eyesShe has long hair. · I have blue eyes.
's got = has gotShe's got brown eyes.

Adjective order

size+age+noun

a tall young man · a big old house

learn.html:

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗

✗

✗

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
Adjective → be. A body part (hair, eyes) → have / has.
⭐

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• be + adjective: He's tall.
  • has / have for hair and eyes.
  • Order: size + age + noun.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: Описываем людей двумя глаголами: be + прилагательное (He's tall) и have/has для волос и глаз (She has long hair).

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?

ru.title: Структура

Порядок прилагательных: размер + возраст → a tall young man.

kk.title: Құрылымы

Сын есім реті: көлем + жас → a tall young man.

ru.title: Итог

• be + прилагательное: He's tall.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
After like, love, hate the second verb takes -ing.

I love dancing. · I hate running.

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
❤️ love (+++)
I love dancing.
👍 like (++)
I like cooking.
👎 hate (––)
I hate running.

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
subject+like / love / hate+verb-ing

Spelling of -ing

most verbsread → reading
verb + edance → dancing (drop the e)
short vowel + consonantrun → running (double it)
➖ NegativeI don't like cooking.

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
I like cook.  ✓ I like cooking.
✗
I love danceing.  ✓ I love dancing.
✗
She like reading.  ✓ She likes reading.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
Two verbs together → the second one gets -ing.
🔊
-ing is /ɪŋ/ — a soft ending, not “-ink”.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• like / love / hate + verb-ing.
  • dance → dancing · run → running.
  • Negative: don't like + -ing.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: После like, love, hate второй глагол получает -ing: I love dancing.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html: like, love, hate-тен кейін екінші етістік -ing алады: I love dancing.

ru.title: Структура
ru.html: Правописание: dance → dancing (убираем e), run → running (удваиваем), read → reading.

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html: Жазылуы: dance → dancing (e түседі), run → running (қосарланады), read → reading.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• like / love / hate + глагол-ing.
  • dance → dancing · run → running.
  • Отрицание: don't like + -ing.

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• like / love / hate + етістік-ing.
  • dance → dancing · run → running.
  • Болымсыз: don't like + -ing.

Order politely with I'd like (= I would like).

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
☕ Order
I'd like a coffee, please.
🍟 Plural
some chips
🚫 Negative
We don't have any juice.

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
a / anone thing you can count → a sandwich, an apple
someplural or uncountable, in + → some chips, some water
anyin − and ? → not any juice · any juice?
I'd like+a / an / some+food, please

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
Hello! What would you like?
I'd like a coffee and some chips, please.
Sorry, we don't have any chips today.

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
I'd like coffee.  ✓ I'd like a coffee.
✗
We don't have some juice.  ✓ We don't have any juice.
✗
I'd like a water.  ✓ I'd like some water.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
some lives in ➕ sentences; any lives in ➖ and ❓.
🗣️
In shops and cafés, I'd like… is the normal polite way to order.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• a / an = one countable thing.
  • some in ➕ · any in ➖ / ❓.
  • Order: I'd like … , please.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: Вежливый заказ: I'd like (= I would like). Перед едой: a/an (одна штука), some (+), any (− и ?).

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html: Сыпайы тапсырыс: I'd like. Тағамның алдында: a/an (бір дана), some (+), any (− және ?).

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
some — в утверждении, any — в отрицании и вопросе.

⚠ Неисчисляемое (water, tea) не берёт a: some water.

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
some — болымды сөйлемде, any — болымсыз бен сұрақта.

⚠ Саналмайтын зат (water, tea) a алмайды: some water.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• a / an = одна счётная вещь.
  • some в ➕ · any в ➖ / ❓.
  • Заказ: I'd like … , please.

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• a / an = бір саналатын зат.
  • some ➕ · any ➖ / ❓.
  • Тапсырыс: I'd like … , please.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html: Two questions about quantity. How much asks about price or things you can't count. How many asks about things you can count.

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
💰 Price
How much is it?
🍎 Countable
How many apples?
💧 Uncountable
How much water?

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
How much+ price / uncountable → How much is it? How much money?
How many+ plural noun → How many apples? How many shoes?
some / anyI have some money. I don't have any euros.
PricesIt's five dollars. It costs ten euros.

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
How much is this bag?
It's five dollars.

Six, if you have some change.

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
How many is it?  ✓ How much is it?
✗
How much apples?  ✓ How many apples?
✗
How many water?  ✓ How much water?

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
Can you count it (one, two, three)? → How many. If not → How much.
⭐
Money is always How much.

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• How much = price / uncountable.
  • How many = countable, plural.
  • some in ➕, any in ➖ / ❓.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: How much — цена или неисчисляемое. How many — то, что можно посчитать.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html: How much — баға не саналмайтын зат. How many — саналатын зат.

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
Проверка: можно посчитать (один, два, три)? → How many. Нет → How much.

Деньги — всегда How much.

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
Тексеру: санауға бола ма (бір, екі, үш)? → How many. Жоқ → How much.

Ақша — әрқашан How much.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• How much = цена / неисчисляемое.
  • How many = счётное, мн. число.
  • some в ➕, any в ➖ / ❓.

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• How much = баға / саналмайтын.
  • How many = саналатын, көпше.
  • some ➕, any ➖ / ❓.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
Talk about right now with be + verb-ing: It's raining.

Or use It's + adjective: It's sunny.

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
🌧️ Happening now
It's raining.
☀️ Weather word
It's sunny. It's cold.
❓ Ask
What's the weather like?

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
It+is+rain-ing

Spelling of -ing

most verbsrain → raining, snow → snowing
verb + eshine → shining
short vowel + consonantrun → running
It's + adjectiveIt's sunny · It's hot · It's cold

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
What's the weather like?
It's raining here. And there?
It's hot and sunny!

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
It raining.  ✓ It's raining.
✗
It's shineing.  ✓ It's shining.
✗
It's rain.  ✓ It's raining.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
Two parts, always: is + -ing. If one is missing, it's wrong.
⭐
A weather verb takes -ing (raining). A weather adjective doesn't (sunny).

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• Now: am/is/are + verb-ing.
  • It's raining / snowing · It's sunny / cold.
  • Ask: What's the weather like?

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html:
Про то, что происходит сейчас: be + глагол-ing → It's raining.

Или It's + прилагательное → It's sunny.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?

Қазір болып жатқан нәрсе: be + етістік-ing → It's raining.

Немесе It's + сын есім → It's sunny.

ru.title: Структура

Правописание: shine → shining, run → running.

kk.title: Құрылымы

Жазылуы: shine → shining, run → running.

ru.title: Итог

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• Қазір: am/is/are + етістік-ing.

  • Сұрақ: What's the weather like?

activities.why: A weather verb takes -ing; a weather adjective does not.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
Let's + verb = a suggestion for you and me: Let's go!

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
🤝 Suggest
Let's watch a film.
🎟️ Invite
Do you want to come?
🙂 Polite invite
Would you like to join us?

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
Let's+base verb
Do you want to+base verb ?

Object pronouns

I → meCall me.
we → usCome with us.
he/she/they → him / her / themAsk them.

⭐

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• Let's + base verb = suggestion.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?

Приглашение: Do you want to…? (по-дружески) / Would you like to…? (вежливо).

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?

Шақыру: Do you want to…? / Would you like to…?

learn.html:
I / he / she / it+was
you / we / they+were

kk.title: Қорытынды

• was → I/he/she/it · were → you/we/they.

learn.title: What is this grammar?
learn.html:
Talk about yesterday. Most verbs add -ed: play → played.

Some verbs are irregular and change completely: go → went.

learn.title: When do we use it?
learn.html:
⚽ Yesterday
I played football.
🏠 Last weekend
I went home.
🍽️ Last year
We ate at a café.

learn.title: Structure & forms
learn.html:
subject+verb + ed

Spelling of -ed

most verbswork → worked, watch → watched
ends in -elive → lived
consonant + ystudy → studied
short vowel + consonantstop → stopped

Irregular verbs — learn these

go → wentsee → saw
have → hadeat → ate
meet → metbe → was / were

learn.title: Everyday conversation
learn.html:
What did you do last weekend?
I played football and I watched a film. Then I went home.
Nice! Was it fun?
Yes, it was great.

learn.title: Common mistakes
learn.html:
✗
I goed home.  ✓ I went home.
✗
She studyed.  ✓ She studied.
✗
He stoped.  ✓ He stopped.

learn.title: Tips
learn.html:
🧠
One form for everybody: I played, she played, they played — no extra -s.
🔊
-ed sounds like /t/ (worked), /d/ (played) or /ɪd/ (wanted).

learn.title: Quick summary
learn.html:
• Regular verbs: add -ed.
  • Spelling: live→lived, study→studied, stop→stopped.
  • Irregular: go→went, see→saw, have→had, eat→ate, meet→met.

ru.title: Что это за грамматика?
ru.html: Прошедшее время. Большинство глаголов добавляют -ed: play → played. Неправильные меняются: go → went.

kk.title: Бұл қандай грамматика?
kk.html: Өткен шақ. Көп етістік -ed қосады: play → played. Бұрыс етістіктер өзгереді: go → went.

ru.title: Структура
ru.html:
Правописание: live → lived, study → studied, stop → stopped.

Форма одна для всех лиц: I played, she played, they played.

kk.title: Құрылымы
kk.html:
Жазылуы: live → lived, study → studied, stop → stopped.

Форма барлық жаққа бірдей: I played, she played, they played.

ru.title: Итог
ru.html:
• Правильные глаголы: -ed.
  • study→studied, stop→stopped.
  • Неправильные: go→went, see→saw, have→had, eat→ate, meet→met.

kk.title: Қорытынды
kk.html:
• Дұрыс етістіктер: -ed.
  • study→studied, stop→stopped.
  • Бұрыс: go→went, see→saw, have→had, eat→ate, meet→met.
